sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Open the work permit to 
 starting the maintenance procedure and receipt the equipment place from 
 the operation after work permit finished.

Check the equipment after that close isolation valves of 
 both sides (HI&LO) for transmitter. figure 
 no. 1

مفتوح 
 فتحات من كلا الجانبين (HI&LO) لجهاز الإرسال.
Connect the calibration pump to HI side.

Install 
 multimeter to take mA reading in the test point or by connect it series in 
 the mA circuit. figure no. 2

Check ZERO of the transmitter with atmospheric pressure at 
 the two sides (HI&LO).

Adjustment ZERO - if the reading of multimeter is less or 
 larger than 4 mA. Turn the ZERO screw of transmitter with a minus 
 screwdriver clockwise or counterclockwise consequently (refer to figure 
 no. 3).

Apply input press of 100 % (300 mmH2O) by the calibration 
 pump to HI side.

Adjustment 
 SPAN - if the reading of multimeter is less or larger than 20 mA. Turn the 
 SPAN screw of transmitter with a minus screwdriver clockwise or 
 counterclockwise consequently (refer to figure no. 3).

Check ZERO and SPAN more than one reading to adjusting at 
 4 & 20 mA exactly.

خذ القراءة عند (0 25 50 75 100) % وتأكد 
 عند (4 8 12 16 20) مللي أمبير بالتالي.

Then if the relation between input and output is within 
 specified limit the calibration is finished.

Remove multimeter from transmitter and connect the 
 terminals.

Remove the calibration pump from HI side of the 
 transmitter.
Open the isolation valves for transmitter.
Close the two vents, now the transmitter in service.

Return the equipment place to the operators after 
 maintenance schedule completed.

إغلاق تصريح العمل وإعادة السلامة للعمل في 
 الوضع الطبيعي.
